abis: Writer helpers use fixed fastcall arguments as declared in coff-writer.h; module completion, timestamp and exit hooks use cdecl. ftell is the standard cdecl long(FILE *) and calls only _lseek.

state_and_data.method: typed contextual state and ordinary literals; no copied sections or linked snapshots
state_and_data.reserved_section_count: original word 0x85198 freezes the header directory; renamed from earlier provisional coff_sections_locked
state_and_data.data_offset: original 0x851b0 accumulates section data bytes; renamed from earlier provisional coff_symbol_count
state_and_data.physical_address: preserved exactly: the .text section header contains physical address 38 after the 38-byte .drectve contribution
state_and_data.contribution_counts: distinct 16-bit relocation and line counts at +0x34 and +0x36
state_and_data.vector_iteration: typed block pointer at +0x14 and separate iteration count/slot at +0x0c/+0x10; null result resets the next walk
state_and_data.cleanup_initializers: 0x83184 and 0x831b8 both read as zero in the original; the former has no writer in this build
state_and_data.timestamp: existing reproducible_build switch at 0x80628 controls the time callback

mask_extent_check.ftell: RET ends at 0x71e84; aligned logical extent ends 0x71e90, before the independently identified CRT fgets function
mask_extent_check.preflight: all driver ranges are checked against each other and against independently identified original CRT ranges before masking

minimal_case_result.comparison: all other bytes match the captured expected object

limits: This establishes the captured minimal-C backend case. Optional listing/debug/FPO output, nonempty relocations and line records, long symbol names, error branches and ftell text/read corner cases are not dynamically validated here; helpers on unvisited paths may still trap. Optimized hello remains queued.
analysis_scope: Extracted historical reconstruction analysis; superseded transport evidence removed, current references in cases/shared-prefix-evidence
